explanation: This tests triple integration in spherical coordinates, absent from the supplied Linear Algebra topics, so it is prerequisite. Taking the positive y-axis as the polar axis gives 0≤θ≤π/2, 0≤φ≤2π, and 0≤r≤2cos(θ). The integrand 1/r² cancels the r² in the volume element, so the integral is 2π∫₀^(π/2)2cos(θ)sin(θ)dθ=2π. The singularity at the origin is integrable.
